instruction: Adjust VS Code settings to automatically convert all my TypeScript files to JavaScript files with proper transpilation every time I save, without using any extensions.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VS Code does not have built-in TypeScript transpilation that automatically converts .ts files to .js files on save. This requires build tools (tsc, webpack, etc.) or extensions to be configured separately.
